request: Analyze GSE297842 for PMID 40789206 (Exercise sensitizes the pressure diuresis response: shifting immune landscapes may underlie renal adaptations.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk poly-A RNA-seq, renal cortex, single-end NextSeq 2000 (S2.8.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: forced treadmill experiment only: Sed, 24 h (pre/post ECT, no training), 1 wk and 2 wk training; n=4 per group (S3.4.p1, FIG6 n=4 per group). The voluntary-wheel experiment had no RNA-seq.
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 2 wk forced treadmill training vs sedentary on renal cortex gene expression in male mice (S3.4.p1, TAB2)
planned_contrasts: 2 wk vs Sed (TAB1, TAB2: 24 DEGs, 17 up / 7 down)
24 h vs Sed (TAB1: 54 DEGs, 34 up / 20 down)
final.normalization: DESeq2 RLE; genes with fewer than ten counts across samples removed (S2.9.p1)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 on HTSeq raw counts of Ensembl protein-coding genes (S2.9.p1)
final.paper_results: 2wk: 24 DEGs incl. Scnn1a/b/g up, Foxi1, Cyp4a14 up, Mmp13, Cd209a down; 1wk: 0; 24h: 54

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.9.p1 give DESeq2 with BH-adjusted p<=0.05 and no fold-change cutoff; TAB1 lists the three comparisons vs Sed with counts; S3.4.p1 states RNA-seq was done on forced treadmill groups only.

checks: GEO treatment protocol describes 1 day / 1 wk / 2 wk forced treadmill at 70% capacity for 40 min, matching S2.1.p3
growth protocol: wild type C57BL/6J male mice
16 GSM samples = 4 groups x 4, matching FIG6 n=4
supplementary file is HTSeq raw counts, matching S2.9.p1

ownership.reasoning: Series, protocol, and sample counts match the paper's treadmill RNA-seq experiment. The deposited matrix also holds 8 extra columns (STC804_17..24, D*_Run / D*_Sed) that have no GSM record in the series and are not described in the paper's RNA-seq section; they are not part of this accession's sample set and are dropped at alignment.

alignment.reasoning: Metadata description holds 'Library name: STC804_<n>_B<k>_<group>_Re_L1...'; matrix columns are 'STC804_<n>_B<k>_<group>_Re_S<n>'. Key = STC804_<n> on both sides (exact). Matrix columns STC804_17..24 (D-prefixed Run/Sed) have no GSM in the series and will be unmatched and dropped. Group from characteristics treatment, cross-checked by the group token in the library name.

matrix.reasoning: integer fraction 1.0, max 2.3M, many zeros; GEO data_processing: HTSeq v0.10.0 read counts, 'raw counts for each sample'; file name htseq_rawCounts; paper S2.9.p1 uses HTSeq raw counts in DESeq2.

candidates.reason_rejected: paper compares each exercise group to Sed separately (TAB1); pooling mixes acute and training estimands

design.reasoning: One control (Sed) with three exercise levels (TAB1). One DESeq2 model on all 16 samples with three planned contrasts vs Sed; 2 wk vs Sed is the primary estimand (TAB2, FIG6). The 24 h group is an acute bout response (S2.1.p3) rather than training.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one sample each; no batch, sex (all male) or other covariate recorded in GEO or the paper.

paper_route.method: DESeq2 on protein-coding genes, genes with < 10 counts across samples removed

deviations: No restriction to protein-coding genes: the deposited matrix has Ensembl gene IDs without biotype, so all genes passing the count filter are tested (this changes the BH denominator slightly).
Low-count filter implemented as mean raw count >= 0.625 over the 16 samples, i.e. total count >= 10 across samples (S2.9.p1).
pydeseq2 rather than R DESeq2; whether the paper fitted one 4-group model or pairwise models is not stated. A pairwise 2wk-vs-Sed DESeq2 run is added as a sensitivity analysis.

method.reasoning: Raw HTSeq counts support the paper's DESeq2 route directly.

threshold.reasoning: S2.9.p1: BH-adjusted p<=0.05; TAB1 header 'p<=0.05; q<=0.05; |log2FC|>=0' (no fold-change cutoff; q<=0.05 implies p<=0.05).

caveats: All genes tested, not only protein-coding (no biotype in deposited matrix).

study.reasoning: Paper-aligned DESeq2 route with the paper's threshold; deviations limited to gene universe and implementation.

discrepancies.paper: RNA-seq on 4 treadmill groups, n=4 (S3.4.p1, FIG6)
discrepancies.data: matrix has 24 columns; 8 (STC804_17..24, D*_Run/D*_Sed) have no GSM record in GSE297842
55,414 Ensembl gene IDs, no biotype column

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: One DESeq2 model on all 16 samples, three planned contrasts vs Sed (TAB1); filter total count >= 10 across samples (S2.9.p1).

executions.name: W2_vs_SED_pairwise
executions.reasoning: Pairwise 2wk vs Sed fit on 8 samples (total count >= 10 over those 8), in case the paper fitted each comparison separately.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper ran clusterProfiler GO/KEGG on the 2 wk DEGs (S2.9.p1, FIG6A).
Paper reports stress-response GO pathways for the 24 h DEGs (Supp Fig 7A).
